== Is Fiordland free? ==
Yes. Free of charge and open source (GPL-3.0).

== Is it Arch? ==
It uses the Arch Linux repositories, so most Arch guides apply. It adds its own installer, package manager, defaults and a repo for its own packages. Please do not report Fiordland-specific problems to Arch.

== How is it different from CachyOS or EndeavourOS? ==
See the [https://fiordlandlinux.org/compare/ comparison page].

== Can I use pacman and flatpak directly? ==
Yes. tawaki is a front end; everything underneath is standard. No AUR helper is installed: tawaki builds AUR packages with <code>makepkg</code> and shows the build script first. If you install paru or yay yourself, tawaki uses it.

== Does it run games? ==
Yes. 32-bit libraries (multilib) and Vulkan drivers are set up by the installer. Install Steam with <code>tawaki install steam</code>.

== How do I update? ==
<code>tawaki update</code> in a terminal. It updates the system, Flatpaks and AUR packages in one go.

== Do I need to reinstall when a new ISO comes out? ==
No. New releases (beta to 1.0, 1.0 to 2.0) come through <code>tawaki update</code>. Package changes and system settings from the new ISO are applied to existing installs automatically. The ISO is only for new installs. See [https://fiordlandlinux.org/docs/updates/ Updates] in the docs.

== Where do I report bugs? ==
On [https://github.com/Fiordland-Linux/fiordland/issues GitHub], or on the [[Help desk]] if you are not sure it is a bug.
